set.body: Replace name-dispatched scalar execution with a lawful scalar-format capability that owns fill parsing, primitive block compatibility, allocation and assembly, and endian encode/decode while retaining allocation-disciplined primitive arrays. Complete the common fixed-width Zarr scalar family needed for broad scientific interoperability. Extend codec compilation and runtime execution with shape-aware array-to-array stages and implement the normative transpose codec. Add the normative v2 chunk-key encoding without weakening default v3 key semantics. Preserve runtime-generic rank and the dependency-free shared kernel. Gates: explicit fill/range and block-type contracts; raw-bit round trips in both endiannesses; transpose permutation, inverse, scalar, rank-five, and invalid-order tests; direct and sharded read/write paths; Zarr-Python differential fixtures; warning-clean zarrJVM/test and zarrJS/test; no NeuroArchive semantics or heavy dependency in core.
set.title: Zarr Z8.1: executable scalar formats, core dtypes, transpose, and v2 chunk keys
